message.content: {"rules":["The closure `f` must perform only async-signal-safe operations when it runs in the child process after `fork`, just before `exec`.","The caller must ensure that `f` does not violate library invariants through invalid use of resources duplicated by `fork`, such as file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.","Panicking in `f` is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted.","`Command` calls `std::panic::always_abort` before invoking `f`; panic message formatting still occurs."]}
